name: LiveXR Workflow
summary:
About "LiveXR Workflow"
"LiveXR Workflow" is a service specialized in procedural and process-based training. It allows users to review formal procedures (the correct path) by replicating various real-world scenarios.

Key Features:

Skill-Based Modes: Offers Beginner and Expert modes to provide tailored training suited to the user's skill level.

Immersive Hands-On Experience: Enables users to interact with objects (grab, move, rotate, etc.) and verify checklist steps within a VR environment.
